content.label: A question from the heart
content.question: When can we come to visit?

answers.title: Plan around holidays
answers.detail: Look at the semester calendar together. Find out now when the long breaks are.

answers.title: Fix a video call time
answers.detail: Set one long call every week. Everyone together, no rush.

answers.title: Share small things
answers.detail: Campus photos, a picture of your food, your friends' names. The distance feels smaller.
